deviations.description: Positive round trip: invoke the script once per new class and confirm it does not exit 1 on enum validation.
deviations.reason: system-defect-record.sh sources deploy-root-guard.sh (line 195), which refuses to run from the agent-system source store (only from a deployed .claude/scripts/ or .opencode/scripts/ tree). Enum validation (the case arm at lines 160-170) runs before that guard is sourced, so all three positive invocations demonstrably passed enum validation (no exit 1 from the case arm) before failing later at the unrelated guard. Running from a temp-deployed copy or the real .claude/ tree was rejected as out of scope: the SOURCE-STORE RULE and the plan's own risk mitigation both expect zero .claude/ hits from this task until an operator-initiated deploy runs.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — verified enum-validation pass-through via the guard's later, unrelated failure rather than a full end-to-end write)*

deviations.description: Confirm git status --short shows exactly the two intended source-store files as modified.
deviations.reason: Phases 1 and 2 each committed their own green sub-step per the Commit-Per-Green-Substep Mandate (git-workflow.md), so by Phase 3 the two source-store files are already committed and no longer appear as modified in git status. The underlying assertion (no .claude/** file created or modified) was verified directly via git status --short and a recursive grep for the three new class names under .claude/, both returning zero hits.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — files already committed via per-phase green commits; verified no .claude/** write directly instead)*
